finding: The available 2023-2024 sources preserve completed lineups but do not preserve receipt-proven pregame active-roster state at T-minus-4. A completed lineup therefore cannot be used to reconstruct target-player availability or validate a historical T-minus-4 start-probability model.
safe_repair: The historical feature store accepts a separately receipted official active roster for each future target and strictly earlier completed lineups only. It emits descriptive counts and conditional prior slot distributions, not target start probabilities or a fallback lineup.
affected_scope: Projected-lineup availability and downstream PA-volume inputs for Hits, HR over 0.5, and Total Bases.
historical_reconstruction: Not performed. No 2023-2024 roster snapshot is represented as a pregame receipt.
candidate_status: No fitted lineup candidate, no downstream batter candidate, and no production probability change were created.
required_before_fit: collect sufficient future official T-minus-4 active-roster receipts
retain independent final lineup labels for those targets
predeclare fitted joint-lineup model family and chronological adjudication before training
evaluate coverage, start and slot calibration, identity and timing, then separately evaluate Hits, HR, and Total Bases
highest_value_next_action: Continue the deployed official active-roster T-minus-4 collector and accumulate a fresh prospective paired roster/lineup panel; do not infer historical availability from final lineups.
